Q1_schemas_ativos.query: SELECT schema_name FROM information_schema.schemata WHERE schema_name NOT IN ('pg_catalog','pg_toast','information_schema') ORDER BY 1
Q1_schemas_ativos.notes: Total 64 schemas (excluindo pg_catalog/pg_toast/information_schema). 26 schemas pg_temp_* / pg_toast_temp_* ativos (conexões abertas). Schemas de negócio: public, auth, cron, extensions, graphql, net, ops, ops_backup, pgbouncer, realtime, storage, supabase_migrations, vault.

Q2_tabelas_public.query: SELECT t.tablename, t.rowsecurity, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policy p WHERE p.polrelid=c.oid) as policies FROM pg_tables t JOIN pg_class c ON c.relname=t.tablename JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.nspname=t.schemaname AND n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE t.schemaname='public' ORDER BY tablename
Q2_tabelas_public.notes: TODAS as 173 tabelas têm rowsecurity=true. 11 tabelas têm RLS ativo mas 0 policies (default-deny para anon/authenticated; acessíveis apenas via service_role — comportamento intencionalmente restritivo).

Q6_sequences.query: SELECT sequencename, last_value, max_value, ... FROM pg_sequences WHERE schemaname='public'
Q6_sequences.notes: Apenas 2 sequences no schema public, ambas bigint (max ~9.2e18). Uso atual: 744 e 619 — pct_used praticamente 0%. Sem risco de overflow.

Q7_triggers.query: SELECT trigger_name, event_object_table, event_manipulation, action_timing, action_statement FROM information_schema.triggers WHERE trigger_schema='public'
